(iterations of K turns of a cached loop, then a Timer 2 read and a BCR2 read into the scratchpad, during an 8,192-word upload by blocks of 16 into a 128-wide rectangle; n the iterations, t each one's end in cycles from the kick's Timer 2 read, b the blocks still to go). No assertions.
